Confusable pairs among the identity lists, the many day-count deadlines and the paired fees, followed by continuation facts on name-change proof, Social Security proof, payment and record privacy; each block ties to one manual page, and hint metadata sits only in the trailing line of a block.

FACT_ID: sec02-R01 | anchor: A02
The Department asks every applicant to prove full legal name and date of birth so it can confirm identity and reduce fraud. [A02]
Why it matters: group identity; difficulty low.
Source: [A02 -> pdf-0022]

FACT_ID: sec02-R02 | anchor: A03
Primary identification includes items such as a certified birth certificate, a valid passport, a military ID or a photo license from another state, while Secondary identification covers supporting items such as check stubs, union cards, work IDs and tax forms. [A03]
Why it matters: group identity; confusable primary versus secondary.
Source: [A03 -> pdf-0023]

FACT_ID: sec02-R03 | anchor: A03
A computerized check stub counts as secondary identification only when the applicant's full name is pre-printed on it. [A03]
Why it matters: group identity; difficulty medium.
Source: [A03 -> pdf-0023]

FACT_ID: sec02-R04 | anchor: A03
A Social Security card used as identification must be the original, never a metal or plastic replica. [A03]
Why it matters: group identity; misconception replica cards.
Source: [A03 -> pdf-0023]

FACT_ID: sec02-R05 | anchor: A04
For a marriage name change, the certificate must be the original or certified copy registered after the wedding, not the license that authorized it. [A04]
Why it matters: group name change; confusable marriage license versus certificate.
Source: [A04 -> pdf-0024]

FACT_ID: sec02-R06 | anchor: A04
A court-document copy is acceptable only if the original signature or seal is affixed to it, and a copy with a copied seal or signature is refused. [A04]
Why it matters: group name change; difficulty high.
Source: [A04 -> pdf-0024]

FACT_ID: sec02-R07 | anchor: A04
Every document is subject to verification with the agency that issued it, and that verification can delay issuance of a permit, license or ID. [A04]
Why it matters: group documents; difficulty low.
Source: [A04 -> pdf-0024]

FACT_ID: sec02-R08 | anchor: A05
A Social Security number can be proven with an original card, a W-2 showing the full number, an employer payroll stub or bank statement with the number, or a health insurance card showing name and number. [A05]
Why it matters: group social security; difficulty medium.
Source: [A05 -> pdf-0025]

FACT_ID: sec02-R09 | anchor: A05
Driver Service Centers accept cash, check, money order, MasterCard, Visa and Discover for a license or ID. [A05]
Why it matters: group fees; difficulty low.
Source: [A05 -> pdf-0025]

FACT_ID: sec02-R10 | anchor: A05
Two look-alike new-resident limits: a newcomer has 30 days after establishing residency to switch to a Tennessee license, but only an out-of-state license expired more than six months triggers the full knowledge, road and vision testing. [A05]
Why it matters: group deadlines; confusable thirty days versus six months.
Source: [A05 -> pdf-0025]

FACT_ID: sec02-R11 | anchor: A06
A learner permit for someone under 18 costs $10.50 for one year, while a permit for someone over 18 costs $5.50 for one year. [A06]
Why it matters: group fees; confusable permit fee by age.
Source: [A06 -> pdf-0026]

FACT_ID: sec02-R12 | anchor: A06
Members of the National Guard and family members of military personnel cannot use the active-duty license extension. [A06]
Why it matters: group military; misconception who qualifies.
Source: [A06 -> pdf-0026]

FACT_ID: sec02-R13 | anchor: A06
Anyone first issued a Tennessee license or photo ID after January 1, 2001 must show citizenship or permanent-residency documents at the first renewal and cannot renew that time by mail or online. [A06]
Why it matters: group renewal; difficulty medium.
Source: [A06 -> pdf-0026]

FACT_ID: sec02-R14 | anchor: A07
Drivers 60 or older may choose a non-photo license by mail or internet, though a photo license helps with boarding flights, Amtrak and cruise ships. [A07]
Why it matters: group renewal; difficulty low.
Source: [A07 -> pdf-0027]

FACT_ID: sec02-R15 | anchor: A07
Two look-alike address rules: the Department record must be updated within 10 days of an address change, but the printed license itself does not have to be reissued. [A07]
Why it matters: group address; confusable record versus card.
Source: [A07 -> pdf-0027]

FACT_ID: sec02-R16 | anchor: A07
The federal Driver Privacy Protection Act bars release of personal information from your driving record without your express consent. [A07]
Why it matters: group records; difficulty low.
Source: [A07 -> pdf-0027]
